quarterly_data.signal: Q1 (Apr-Jun 2026, prepared remarks only): net sales JPY 741 billion, up JPY 205.3 billion or +38.3% YoY; operating profit JPY 86.3 billion, +53%; profit before tax JPY 94.5 billion (+64%); net profit JPY 80.6 billion; quarterly EPS JPY 42.45 - record highs in net sales and at every level of profit for a first quarter. FX added ~JPY 72.5 billion to sales and ~JPY 11.3 billion to OP. Backdrop: ICT production including smartphones declined YoY on tight memory supply/demand and higher memory prices, while nearline HDD demand for AI data centers remained robust and all four segments grew sales and OP YoY. Operating cash flow was negative JPY 19.2 billion and free cash flow negative JPY 79.4 billion (working capital build, withholding-tax timing, Linergy acquisition in the battery segment - investing outflow JPY 60.2 billion), with minimal impact on medium-term capital allocation.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 net sales JPY 741 billion +38.3% YoY; OP JPY 86.3 billion +53%; record first-quarter highs; EPS JPY 42.45

quarterly_data.signal: Passive Components: net sales JPY 176.8 billion +28% YoY, operating profit JPY 17.4 billion (~2.7x YoY) - sales for AI data center applications increased significantly. Ceramic capacitors posted higher sales and profits driven by strong AI data center demand with improved profitability; aluminum film capacitors benefited from higher sales to both automotive and AI data centers; inductive devices grew on automotive demand. QoQ, passive components sales +14.1% and OP +52.5%, again with ceramic and aluminum film capacitors rising on AI data centers.
quarterly_data.figure: Passive Components sales JPY 176.8 billion +28% YoY, OP JPY 17.4 billion ~2.7x; AI data center applications up significantly

quarterly_data.signal: Magnetic Application Products: net sales JPY 81.6 billion +49.6% YoY, operating profit JPY 9.6 billion +51.8% - HDD market demand remains strong on expanding AI data center demand; HDD head shipment volume +36% and HDD suspension shipment volume +31% YoY (QoQ heads +12%, suspensions +8%). R&D expenses rising in the HDD head business advancing next-generation technologies such as HAMR. Sensor Application Products sales JPY 61.9 billion +33.3% with OP JPY 7.8 billion (~3x); Energy Application Products sales JPY 405.8 billion +42.1% with OP JPY 69.4 billion +25.3% (small-battery price adjustments, battery pack expansion, mid-sized industrial batteries; JPY 2.6 billion one-time gain on EV power supply business transfer).
quarterly_data.figure: Magnetic sales JPY 81.6 billion +49.6%; HDD head shipments +36%, suspensions +31% YoY on AI data center demand

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 outlook (FX-neutral, JPY 150/USD assumption) - sales in all segments expected to exceed beginning-of-year projections: Passive Components +2%-5% (automotive inductive devices plus AI server products such as aluminum electrolytic capacitors), Sensors +3%-6% (ICT seasonality: magnetic sensors, MEMS microphones), Magnetic Application +6%-8% (head volume +10%, suspension assemblies ~+6%, including captive-designated volume), Energy +9%-12% (smartphone production to peak in Q2; small battery volume ~+10%, mid-sized industrial batteries growing). Full-year FY2027 forecast maintained at beginning-of-year levels while Q1 significantly exceeded projections; memory supply tightness and higher memory prices remain the drag on ICT-related production.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 segment growth guides: passives +2-5%, sensors +3-6%, magnetic +6-8%, energy +9-12%; full-year forecast unchanged
